title: Humanoid-GPT: Scaling Data and Structure for Zero-Shot Motion Tracking
hook: What happens when you train whole-body humanoid control like a language model? A GPT-style transformer on 2 billion frames of motion that tracks new moves it never saw in training.
key_points: A GPT-style causal transformer for whole-body humanoid control, replacing the shallow MLP trackers used before.
Pre-trained on a 2-billion-frame retargeted corpus unifying major mocap datasets plus large in-house recordings.
Scaling both data and model capacity breaks the usual agility-vs-generalization trade-off.
Shows strong zero-shot generalization to unseen motions and control tasks while tracking highly dynamic behaviors.
content_html: Humanoid motion tracking — getting a robot to reproduce a reference movement with its whole body — has been held back by two things: small datasets and a stubborn trade-off where models good at agile motions generalized poorly, and vice versa. Humanoid-GPT borrows the recipe that worked for language: a big transformer trained on a lot of data.
extra_html:
How it works

The model is a GPT-style transformer with causal attention, trained for whole-body control on a 2-billion-frame corpus. That corpus is built by retargeting and unifying all the major motion-capture datasets together with large-scale in-house recordings — a deliberate bet that scale of data, not clever architecture, is the missing ingredient. The authors scale both the dataset and the model capacity together and study how performance grows.

Why it matters

The result is a single generative transformer that tracks highly dynamic behaviors and generalizes zero-shot to motions and control tasks it never saw during training — the agility-generalization trade-off that constrained earlier MLP trackers largely dissolves. It's another data point for the broader thesis that the "scale data and a general architecture" playbook from language and vision transfers to embodied control.

related.title: π0: A Vision-Language-Action Model
related.hook: π0 is a generalist robot policy: it takes camera images, joint angles, and a plain-language instruction, and outputs smooth action sequences — folding laundry, bussing tables, bagging groceries.

related.title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models
related.hook: Treat a robot's actions as just more text tokens, and a vision-language model can learn to act — carrying its web knowledge into the physical world.

prereqs.title: Attention Is All You Need
prereqs.hook: Drop recurrence and convolution, keep only attention — and you get a model that trains in parallel and powers nearly every LLM since.
